external_mass_shape_definition: at each quadrature node the external normalized tangent is split into its projection parallel to the external state restriction (mass/rescaling) and its orthogonal shape change
fit_definition: maximum absolute sampled-root overlap with one fixed-spin Slater determinant; restart 0 uses root-masked natural orbitals and remaining restarts are random
gain_fraction_definition: path-integrated exact external energy derivative carried by the projected tangent divided by total external gain
interpretation_guard: gain fraction must be compared with motion fraction; gain enrichment above motion enrichment is evidence that the fitted Slater channel selectively carries useful external descent
motion_fraction_sq_definition: path integral of projected external tangent squared norm divided by the path integral of total external tangent squared norm
moving_subspace_definition: closest-Slater state plus all spin-conserving occupied-virtual orbital tangents, fitted to sampled-root coefficients of the pre-update wavefunction
projection_definition: orthogonal projection of the batch-external normalized JVP onto the external restriction of the fitted coefficient-space subspace
